name: Cohere
summary: Enterprise-focused foundation-model provider emphasizing private deployment.
overview: Cohere builds language models and AI tools for enterprise customers.

facts.label: Latest disclosed financing
facts.note: Cohere announced a $500M round in August 2025 and a $100M second close in September.

bull_case: Privacy, security, and deployment flexibility can resonate with regulated buyers.
bear_case: Frontier-model leaders have larger capital bases and faster product cycles.

intelligence.description: Cohere builds secure, customizable foundation models and agentic software for enterprise and government customers.
company: Cohere differentiates itself from consumer-first model labs through private deployment, data control and enterprise integrations.
Its product line includes large language models and North, a security-first agentic AI platform.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Cohere is one of the clearest private-market plays on enterprise AI adoption rather than consumer chatbot distribution. Its customer requirements make sovereignty, deployment and trust central to the investment case.

changed.text: Raised $500M at a $6.8B valuation, then added a $100M second close.
Expanded its enterprise and sovereign-AI positioning internationally.

takeaways: Cohere sells control and customization alongside model capability.
Enterprise deployment can produce stickier demand than consumer AI, but sales cycles are longer.
It remains capital constrained relative to the largest frontier labs.
